items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I don't mean he was never like Johnny Hodges.

ctx.x: pretty early. We had to send Coughy back, that's right, yes. Coughy didn't quite, didn't quite make it. Not like Earl did. He wasn't quite, he wasn't a lead man that Earl is. And he wasn't soloist.
Earl has never been a hell of a soloist, but he was better than- Coughy . He wasn't a bad soloist, I don't mean that. I don't mean he was never like Johnny Hodges.
No, but he could take care of this, now did Earl take care of the conducting?
